tasks.label: Build .kubekext
tasks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bun run build.ts && OUT=$(bun -e 'const m = require("./kubek-extension.json"); console.log(m.id.split(".").pop() + "-" + m.version + ".kubekext")') && rm -f *.kubekext && zip -r "$OUT" kubek-extension.json tsconfig.json backend frontend locales icon.png && echo "Packed: $OUT"
